source_contracts.reason: An inert private module delegates to native lan_open_container. It neither creates an invocation nor changes actor/Ready/epoch itself; preserve exact caller and guest-station-open contract. Native menu/item side effects are not a no-op claim.

Immutable Game/LanHost reads plus fresh HashSet, pure area plane and native under_spawn_protection. Retain exact source/namespace/read dependencies; no native identity, Ready, epoch, ID or cloud mutation.

Native fill_held delegates consumption/inventory/possible overflow spawn. Earlier native ID consumption is permitted: cloud has no reserved ID yet and checks the current successor immediately before its pure factory/reserve/take-ID/push tail. Do not claim no allocator activity.

Only the two exact TConstruct command strings mutate inventory and Break; all other strings Continue. No native actor/Ready/epoch/next-ID/cloud assignments. A changed held item before cloud charging is a separate consumer check, not a permission proof for commands.

Runs exact source-fluid-return live before native close. Guest menu/item returns and any native drop allocation occur before a later cloud commit, not between the cloud successor/reserve/ID/push operations. Preserve gi/conn selection and native guest_menu_op/as_guest restoration.

Runs exact live returns for obsolete menus before native ticking. It must retain the existing collected indices and menu predicate; no fake actor attribution is inferred. Prior IDs may advance without violating the cloud current-successor check.

Handles exact named machine/chest/menu domains and otherwise Continues to native open. Menu closure/opening and packet effects are retained, not suppressed. Preserve native owner setup/restore and fixed TConstruct delegates; this hook is not inside the cloud atomic publication tail.

Retain the remote-material-wire flag gate and native coordinate range before saved-NBT removal, plus exact cache removals. World storage mutation is real, but this body does not change native actor/lifecycle/epoch/next-ID/cloud fields and does not run within the cloud publication tail.
Noncancelling packet HEAD writes only area_guest_hits for PlayerAction START/STOP. Native actual guest admission/body/acting tuple setup remains after this hook.
Noncancelling destroy HEAD rechecks exact read-only native protection and updates only area_guest_hits. No owner swap or cancellation is introduced.
UseItemOn noncancelling HEAD captures read-only protection into transform_guest_hits before native as_guest. No attribution is taken from this mod map.

Only PlayerAction START enters the glowing/as_guest branch. UseItemOn immediately Continues without that action. Keep native as_guest setup/restore and exact Break/Continue behavior; do not call it globally side-effect-free.

enter_guest noncancelling HEAD updates only glow_guest_protection using the actual borrowed host. Preserve native body/tuple setup order and exact map type; its numeric map entry is not cloud authority.

Only the exact materials_book CustomPayload channel enters the page/packet branch. UseItemOn immediately Continues. Retain mutable page resolver behavior and its own Guide contract; no claim about book authority follows from cloud review.

Before guest ticks, delegates to exact update_viewers/menu operations. Retain native owner restoration and inventory/drop effects; they are separate operations before a later cloud ID allocation, not re-entry into its tail.

Only splash/lingering bottle items enter this branch; native use_potion_item handling is separate from the TConstruct block cloud entry. Preserve ray/protection/actor/filled-item/native event behavior and possible earlier allocation.

At every packet entry removes prior pending work before branch snapshots. For UseItemOn no Interact packet/scope is inserted. Fix all three state types and exact ordering; this observation does not grant the later target-swap authority.

lan_swing_back HEAD removes pending and returns immediately if absent. In the fixed composition only interact/interact_entity queue writers insert pending; UseItemOn HEAD clears it before block cloud use. Keep target swaps and native restore for Interact as separate behavior.

Only an exact matching Interact packet-id/held splashing item and eligible target can adjust real guest yaw/pitch. The native look_at_entity result is not a cloud owner capability; retain bounds and Break contract.
close/tick delegates to native menu return before later cloud commit
menu update_viewers delegates through native guest_menu_op, outside cloud commit
read-only protection plane used by the exact area-protection module
the other pending interaction writer; never synthesizes a block-cloud owner
sole block-cloud caller, explicit frame/held check and partial accounting
protection predicate used by the exact empty-bottle hook
mixed glow continuation after cloud publication; frame/held checked before charge
named machine open/use delegate; no interposition in cloud publication tail
named menu validation delegate
native item entry predecessor; handled crop path cancels before cloud entry
